deploy/k8s/api-deployment.yaml:21 — readiness and liveness probe to the same port with no distinct paths confirmed distinct — /healthz and /livez are named separately which is correct, but readinessProbe has no failureThreshold or initialDelaySeconds, so a slow-starting container is marked unready and killed by liveness before it ever serves traffic — add initialDelaySeconds: 10 and failureThreshold: 3 to the readinessProbe
